pages.title: Six Stages
pages.text: Each remnant has six stages: $(l)Dormant$(), $(l)Latent$(), $(l)Awakened$(), $(l)Ascended$(), $(l)Transcendent$(), $(l)Apex$().$(br2)Anyone can use up to Awakened. Ascended and Transcendent need the Oathbound Relic. Apex also needs 99.5% Branded Progress.$(br2)A remnant above your limit keeps its stage but only works at your limit.

pages.title: Upgrading
pages.text: Hold the remnant in your $(l)main hand$() and the catalyst in your $(l)offhand$(), then use the remnant.$(br2)Dormant -> Latent: $(item)oathboundrelics:oblivion_stone$()$(br)Latent -> Awakened: $(item)oathboundrelics:void_ashes$()$(br)Awakened -> Ascended: $(item)oathboundrelics:mirrorsteel_idol$()$(br)Ascended -> Transcendent: $(item)minecraft:nether_star$()$(br)Transcendent -> Apex: $(item)oathboundrelics:soul_gem$()

pages.title: Getting One
pages.text: See $(l:oathboundrelics:titans_remnants/acquisition)Finding Dormant Remnants$() for every drop source and chance.
